paper.title: Algorithm 773: SSRFPACK: Interpolation of scattered data on the surface of a sphere with a surface under tension
paper.venue: ACM TOMS 23(3), pp. 435-442 (Sep 1997); paper text not reachable (paywalled, no preprint found)

code.commit: netlib TOMS archive 773.gz (scouted 2026-11-27, sha256 410dc35305f8f08c27f318bcf459e572c52daef78b8470ed4b8288ba85bd1807); shell archive with Doc/, Src/Sp/src.f (SSRFPACK), Drivers/Sp/driver.f (SSRFTEST), Drivers/Sp/data, Drivers/Sp/RES, Drivers/Sp/MSG, Drivers/Sp/SIG. Needs STRIPACK (Algorithm 772, netlib toms/772) to link.

claim.location: Shipped driver Drivers/Sp/driver.f (SSRFTEST, MFLAG and VT flags set in its DATA statements) run on Drivers/Sp/data (33 nodes). It writes the NI x NJ = 32 x 32 grid of fitted values FF(K), K=(J-1)*NI+I, to ssrftest.out. The shipped reference output Drivers/Sp/RES records that grid; the claim is the entry I=16, J=16 (K=496), which is the 8th-digit value 0.44416130E+00 on line 562 of RES (lines 67-1090 hold FF; header lines 1-2 are NI and NJ, then 32 PLAT and 32 PLON lines).

reference.file: Drivers/Sp/RES (grid output FF at K=496) of the shipped SSRFTEST run

claim.metric: FF(I=16,J=16) of the SSRFTEST output grid, single-precision value as printed in RES (E15.8)
claim.paper_value: 0.44416130E+00 (shipped reference output; the paper text was not reachable, so no printed table value was checked)

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The reference is printed to 8 significant digits (half-unit 5e-9 at this value) by a REAL (single-precision) code, whose rounding over a 1024-point surface fit is of order 1e-7. 1e-6 absolute is about 200 times the print precision and an order of magnitude above single-precision noise, yet far below the difference a wrong tension or branch choice makes (the RES values span -0.33 to 1.0).

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 1 minute (one fit of 33 nodes and one 32x32 evaluation after compiling).
cost.data_size: About 1 KB of node data (shipped in Drivers/Sp/data).
cost.data_licence: Netlib TOMS code under the ACM licence of the archive; the rerun should record the licence it finds.

why: The shipped driver fits a surface under tension to 33 scattered nodes on the sphere and evaluates it on a grid; a rebuild must run the GRADL/INTRC1 fit with tension factors to reproduce the reference grid, so the single value cannot be obtained by reading the code.
